title: Issue map: the details card shows who opened each issue
summary: The issue map's details card, in the app and the exported HTML map, now says who opened each issue ('opened by unknown' for a missing or ghost author); built and approved, but not merged because GitHub Actions is disabled on the repository.
friction: GitHub Actions is disabled on nachogl1/maestro (dispatch returns HTTP 422; no PR Checks or Release run since 2026-11-10, PRD PR #558 merged with 0 checks) — every story stops at 'no checks reported' and the self-update pipeline is dead until the owner re-enables Actions
lessons_learned: CLAUDE.md says skip-count baseline 0, but cargo test reports 1 ignored test on main (core::mcp_settings::tests::smoke_get_status_real_files); the baseline line should say 1 for Rust or every dev agent flags it
